title: Code and evaluation records for: High AUROC, Unreliable Thresholds: Uncertainty-Aware Threshold Calibration for Tuberculosis Chest-Radiograph Classifiers
description:
Code and saved evaluation records for a study of tuberculosis chest-radiograph classifiers built on frozen RAD-DINO features. Classifiers were developed on Shenzhen, and their validation-selected thresholds were transferred unchanged to Montgomery and a duplicate-screened TBX11K cohort. The archive covers threshold-selection uncertainty, a proposed uncertainty-aware threshold calibration (Neyman-Pearson order-statistic rule), negative-case spectrum, calibration, and secondary encoder and preprocessing comparisons. Scripts regenerate every figure and table of the article from saved per-image scores. Raw radiographs and model binaries are not included.

Code is released under the MIT licence; derived evaluation records under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md).
